spans.s:
Bode,Ⓒv. t.ⒹSuBASuBaM sUc 10; Avid c., kaT 10, prAk SaMs 1 P; See Predict; ‘absence of delay b(ode)s future success’ avyAkzepo BavizyaMtyAH kAryasidDerhi lakzaRaM (R. x. 6); ‘b(ode)s evil to the country’ janapadasya anizwaSaMsi-sUcaka, aSuBacihnaM-lakzaRaM.
Ⓝ[Bode]ment,Ⓒs.ⒹSuBASuBalakzaRaM; pUrvacihnaM, nimittaM.

Body,Ⓒs.ⒹSarIraM, kAyaH, dehaH, vigrahaH, aMgaM, vapus n., kalevaraM, tanu-nU f., gAtraM; ‘dead b(ody)’ SavaH-vaM, kuRapaH.
Ⓑ
 2 (‘Some b(ody)’) kaH or kA or kim-api or cit or cana; janaH, lokaH.
Ⓑ
 3 padArTaH, vastu n.
Ⓑ
 4 samavAyaH, samUhaH, saMGAtaH, vfMdaM; samAjaH, samudAyaH; ‘in a b(ody)’ sameta a.; saMhata a.; ekatra milita a.
Ⓑ
 5 samAgamaH, SreRI.
Ⓑ
 6 kAMqaH-qaM, skaMDaH; ‘b(ody) of the house’ garBaH, aByaMtaraM, udaraM; ‘b(ody) of troops’ sEnyadalaM; ‘b(ody) guard’ AsannaparicArakaH-rikA, parivAragaRaH.
ⓃBodiless,Ⓒa.Ⓓa (an) in comp. with (s.); anaMga, &c.
ⓃBodily,Ⓒa.ⒹSArIrika-dEhika-kAyika (kI f.); gen. (s.) in comp.; ‘b(odily) pain’ SarIravedanA, dehakleSaH &c.
Ⓔadv.ⒹsaSarIraM, sAMgaM.
Ⓑ
 2 sAkalyena.
